### EQ002 — Level-1 QAOA state and approximation ratio

*Defines the blue-bar variational expectation divided by the exact Ising maximum.*

|\Psi_H(\beta,\gamma)\rangle=e^{i\beta\sum_jX_j}e^{i\gamma H}|+^n\rangle,\quad r_{\rm QAOA}=\max_{\beta,\gamma}\langle H\rangle/E_{\max}
$$

### EQ003 — Closed-form level-1 edge correlation

*Computes every QAOA energy term and every RQAOA rounding correlation without a quantum simulator.*

$$
M_{uv}=\frac{s^2}{2}\prod_{p\ne u,v}\cos[2\gamma(J_{up}-J_{vp})]-\frac{s^2}{2}\prod_{p\ne u,v}\cos[2\gamma(J_{up}+J_{vp})]+cs\sin(2\gamma J_{uv})\left(\prod_{p\ne u,v}\cos(2\gamma J_{up})+\prod_{p\ne u,v}\cos(2\gamma J_{vp})\right)
$$

status: `verified` · source: Appendix C, Lemma 4, Eq. (C9)

Code: `src/rqaoa.py::qaoa1_coefficients`, `src/rqaoa.py::qaoa1_at_gamma`


### EQ004 — RQAOA correlation rounding

*Eliminates one variable and merges its incident couplings into the retained variable.*

$$
(i,j)=\arg\max_{(u,v)\in E}|M_{uv}|,\qquad Z_j=\operatorname{sgn}(M_{ij})Z_i
$$

status: `verified` · source: main Eq. (15); Appendix C pseudocode

### EQ005 — Exact Ising normalization

*Normalizes both algorithms by a separately proved exact optimum.*

$$
E_{\max}=\max_{z\in\{-1,+1\}^n}\sum_{u<v}J_{uv}z_uz_v,\qquad r=E_{\rm algorithm}/E_{\max}
$$
